patthana18.5:1.1: Hetuṃ āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:2.1: Hetuṃ noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu nanoāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:3.1: Nahetuṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nanahetu nasāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:4.1: Hetuṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:5.1: Hetuṃ āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naāsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana18.5:6.1: Hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naāsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:7.1: Hetuṃ āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naāsavo ceva naanāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:8.1: Hetuṃ sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu naanāsavo ceva nano ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:9.1: Hetuṃ āsavañceva āsavasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naāsavo ceva naāsavavippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:10.1: Nahetuṃ āsavasampayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu naāsavavippayutto ceva nanoāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:11.1: Nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nanahetu āsavavippayutto nasāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Lokiyasadisaṃ.)
patthana18.5:12.1: Hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu āsavavippayutto naanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu āsavavippayutto naanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavañca nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu āsavavippayutto naanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
